0x000882.en: 「At my level now...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008F3.en: 「Gah!@ So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00097B.en: 「Damn it!@ Next time you won't get me!」

0x000AA4.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000ADC.en: 「Oh dear...@ That's just not a good look, geez!」

0x000BE0.en: 「Like I'd screw up in a place like this...!@ Not funny...」

0x000C34.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CA8.en: 「Gah! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D85.en: 「This is the end... I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E31.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E7E.en: 「Well, I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EBC.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F03.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FAE.en: 「Ngh... So I become a shooting star after all... Ejecting!」

0x001157.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00119E.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011D3.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0012BF.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x00130D.en: 「No good, I can't go on! Retreating!」

0x0013C8.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0013F7.en: 「Oh no! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001435.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x001464.en: 「I can't go any further. If you'll excuse me.」

0x0014EF.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x00153D.en: 「T-to fall in a place like this...!」

0x001713.en: 「Gaaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0019B1.en: 「...The removal of the ZLAI system is complete.@ Once we adjust the DML system and LIOH,@ Jinrai will be a machine piloted by a human.」

0x001A84.en: 「So Jinrai had a DML system@ installed as well...」

0x001AF6.en: (Then... does that mean I can pilot it too...?)

0x001B33.en: 「With this, Jinrai may truly become@ the third Dynamic General Guardian@ in every sense of the name.」

0x001BCC.en: 「No... considering all that's happened, Jinrai@ isn't worthy of that title...」

0x001C5F.en: 「Jinrai will be reborn by your hand.@ There are spare Double G parts on Itiiti Island.@ Use them to repair the damaged sections.」

0x001D44.en: 「There are also leg booster units being developed@ for the Aussenseiter and DyGenGuard.@ Use them if you need to.」

0x001E32.en: 「If Jinrai can be operated without trouble,@ I'd like to select a pilot soon as well.」

0x001EAC.en: 「On our end, we have to fill the gap@ left by Second Lieutenant Hugo...」

0x001F8F.en: (Someone you saw just yesterday, suddenly gone...@ I thought I understood that, but this...)

0x00201E.en: 「Touma... thanks to your words,@ I've resolved to set Jinrai right.」

0x0020A5.en: 「Jinrai isn't worthy of the Dynamic General@ Guardian name, but...」

0x002122.en: 「Like the DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter, I'll have it@ reborn as a guardian of this world.」

0x0021AE.en: 「Then... maybe you should change@ the name 'Jinrai' too, huh?」

0x002226.en: 「Yeah,@ if a new form and purpose come from your hands...」

0x0022C0.en: 「She's been shut in her room ever since.@ Major Kai said to let her rest for a while...」

0x002350.en: 「Word is her old teacher was@ piloting that Medius Locus, wasn't it?」

0x0023C1.en: 「Yes... I've been through something similar,@ but for her it's a double shock...」

0x002463.en: 「It sounds cruel, but unless she settles things@ with Erde Mitte herself,@ it'll haunt her forever...」

0x002521.en: 「Will Second Lieutenant Aqua find her resolve?」

0x002558.en: 「I think she will.@ She seems strong at the core.」

0x0025D0.en: 「I agree with Lieutenant Katina.@ For now, let's just watch over her... and once she@ makes up her mind and stands up, we'll all support her.」

0x00268F.en: 「Captain, we've surfaced.@ No enemy craft in the surrounding airspace.」

0x0026EB.en: 「Then launch the patrol craft at once.@ After that, crash dive.」

0x00279D.en: 「Through my subordinates, I got word from@ Dr. Hamill at the BF base. The Mk-X's black hole@ engine and parts are nearly adjusted, he says.」

0x00286F.en: 「And he wants to transfer it here.」

0x0028BC.en: 「A Federation transport plane.@ Its crew and escort are all intelligence agents.@ That keeps the Federation off us, but...」

0x0029B3.en: 「We know that risk, but...@ it's the fastest option we have.」

0x002A27.en: 「Also, if contact proves difficult,@ we'll turn the transport back.」

0x002A86.en: 「Understood.@ Let's pray the cargo arrives safely.」

0x002AE0.en: 「Dragon 2 from TD4.@ Patrol of areas 24 through 35 complete.@ No enemy sighted within search range.」

0x002B71.en: 「TD4 from Dragon 2.@ This ship is on its planned course.@ Return to ship on the set route.」

0x002C3D.en: 「Yeah...@ I know it's a war,@ and I've steeled myself for it...」

0x002CB2.en: 「Even now, from what we've done... no, in plenty of other places too... I know there are people who feel the way I do, but...」

0x002D90.en: 「Even so...@ when a face I know... someone close to me is gone...」

0x002E08.en: 「How long is this going to go on...」

0x002E42.en: 「Even when it's hard, we must move forward... If we don't survive, the feelings and deeds of the dead will be buried and forgotten.」

0x002EF3.en: 「It may be cold comfort, but@ that's all I can tell you right now.」

0x002F4F.en: (That's right... we have to keep flying...@ for Filio's sake, and for our own too)

0x00300F.en: 「To meet the Altairlion here...!@ Is this what they call the hand of fate?」

0x003093.en: 「Why here of all places... and alone?」

0x0030D0.en: 「Could it be that this time@ Sleigh's coming over to our side...?」

0x003123.en: 「Because she lost to GRaMXs last time?@ So she's just going to do nothing...? You think Sleigh's@ pride would ever let that slide?」

0x0031BF.en: (But coming alone like this...@ maybe there's some other reason)

0x003230.en: 「To meet here, just the two of us... is this fate too?@ Forget that woman's request, do what you must do...」

0x0032FF.en: 「Then... there's only one thing to do!」

0x003330.en: 「Heh... so you understood my intent.@ ...I hate to admit it, but deep down@ it seems we're alike...」

0x0033C9.en: 「Before we settle everything, I want to ask you.@ Ibis, what do you intend to do@ with that Altairlion...?」

0x00346B.en: 「To fly across the galaxy...@ and before that, protect our world.」

0x0034D0.en: 「Let me ask you in turn.@ Sleigh, what do you intend to do@ with that Vegalion?」

0x003584.en: 「I knew it. I have nothing left now...」

0x0035C4.en: 「Back in <DC>, and then <Project TD>,@ it was all for Brother... to see Brother smile...@ I flew for that, and that alone...」

0x003685.en: 「After I lost Brother,@ all I had left was chasing@ the Series 77...」

0x0036FD.en: 「So to take back the Altairlion, I got in@ this Vegalion, the one Brother's hands@ never directly touched...」

0x003796.en: 「He designed it, yes, but@ Brother's soul isn't in this machine...@ Empty, like me, even when I pilot it...」

0x003844.en: 「Even with the Vegalion and Altairlion,@ there's nothing beyond that for me...」

0x0038B2.en: 「It's pathetic... I was jealous of you,@ getting the Asterion and Altairlion,@ trying to carry on Brother's dream.」

0x003957.en: 「As if you'd taken my Brother...@ taken everything of his from me.」

0x0039CC.en: 「But I realized there was one thing@ left to me after all. And that is...」

0x003A7A.en: 「Brother has nothing to do with this fight...@ On my own pride, by my own will,@ I'll defeat you, my greatest rival!」

0x003B0D.en: 「...Sleigh, you finally spoke in your own words.」

0x003B63.en: 「Your feelings for Filio...@ if you come at me with a will stronger than that,@ yes, with your own will...」

0x003BF9.en: 「I'll put everything on the line too, and take you on!」

0x003C33.en: 「Sleigh!@　If I win, you're gonna do@　whatever I say!」

0x003CAB.en: 「Fine by me! But if I'm the one who wins!」

0x003D10.en: 「I'll... figure that out when it happens!」

0x003D63.en: 「I won't lose, Sleigh!@　And I'm gonna show you!@　The dream Filio and the rest of us shared!」

0x003DF0.en: 「The pride I've got left, my stubborn will!@　I'll show you just how much it's worth!」

0x003E5B.en: 「Same goes for me!@　The will and the power I inherited@　from Filio... I'll prove it to you!!」

0x003EF4.en: 「Ibis, at this rate we're gonna lose either the Altairlion or the Vegalion...!」

0x003F72.en: 「Today we settle it, no holding back!@　Otherwise we can't move forward!」

0x003FDA.en: 「And whatever happens to the Altairlion and Vegalion... we're gonna fly!!」

0x00407F.en: 「That's right, Ibis! No mercy, no restraint!@　We stake everything and settle this!」

0x0040F0.en: 「And I'll surpass you!@　By my own will!!」

0x0041B2.en: 「You can't run now! It's over, Sleigh!!」

0x0041FB.en: 「Kh, uugh...! Shoot, Ibis...!@　I won't live on in disgrace...!」

0x0042AC.en: 「Scold your foolish little sister... big brother...」

0x004323.en: 「I'll scold you in Filio's place!@　Dying in a place like this, what were you thinking, idiot!@　Idiot, idiot!!」

0x0043CF.en: 「Living in disgrace...!? Back in the DC days@　I lost to you again and again, crashed@　over and over...!」

0x004471.en: 「But I'm alive!@　As long as I'm alive, I believed I could@　make my dream come true someday!」

0x0044E3.en: 「There are people who died before their dreams came true...@　before they could accomplish anything...!」

0x00455A.en: 「For their sake too, those of us still alive@　have to fight with everything until the very end...!」

0x0045E6.en: 「That's why I kept flying, and made it this far...!@　By my own will... for my dream...!」

0x004666.en: 「And for that dream, I need the Altairlion, the Vegalion... and you, Sleigh... I need you too!」

0x0046FF.en: (Ibis... to settle everything, you met Sleigh head-on...)

0x004777.en: 「...It's a promise, Sleigh...@　You're gonna do what I say...」

0x0047D9.en: 「Together with us, you're gonna@　carry on Filio's dream too.」

0x004835.en: 「Remember, Sleigh...@　You said being in Project TD@　wasn't your own choice, but...」

0x0048CE.en: 「Carrying on Filio's will, flying@　the sea of stars... do you hate that?」

0x004968.en: 「That's right, Sleigh...@　You'd just lost sight of your own dream.」

0x0049C7.en: 「I'm asking you too.@　Not just for Filio, but for yourself,@　come back to us.」

0x004A54.en: 「As comrades who weave the same dream...」

0x004AC3.en: 「What are you doing here, Sleigh Presty? Challenging the Altairlion alone...?」

0x004B49.en: 「Or are you planning to join up with the Steel Dragons?」

0x004BAE.en: 「Either way,@　that wasn't very professional of you.」

0x004C07.en: 「I'm with the Gaia Sabers now.@　Side with the Steel Dragons and I'll cut you down as a traitor.@　With this Psylion.」

0x004CA3.en: 「I'm to prove the worth of this Psylion,@　supplied to us by Isurugi.」

0x004D2A.en: 「Successor to the Carion...@　a new Isurugi machine developed using@　the know-how from Project TD...」

0x004DBA.en: 「Yes, not an experimental machine like the Altairlion or Vegalion, but a pure military unit.」

0x004E28.en: 「You could say it's what Project TD@　was always meant to become.」

0x004E8D.en: 「Don't screw with me!@　Our project was never meant to@　create something like that!」

0x004F0E.en: 「And yet this machine exists.@　You knew that all along, didn't you?」

0x004F76.en: 「In fact, Isurugi kept Project TD alive to@　produce machines like this... and you all@　went along with it.」

0x005043.en: 「My current employer wants superior weapons. Hand over the Altairlion and Vegalion, and I might reconsider how you're treated.」

0x0050FD.en: 「I won't hand over either the Altairlion or the Vegalion! And I've got no intention of fighting you!」

0x00516E.en: 「Oh? And on what grounds do you say that?」

0x0051A8.en: 「The ones we should be fighting now are@　the Ruina, the Guests, the Baral!@　This is no time for humans to fight each other!」

0x00526C.en: 「...Quite the twisted way to beg for your life.@　Then I'll take that machine by force.@　No guarantees on your life.」

0x005330.en: 「Ibis, we're outnumbered!@　Think about pulling back!」

0x005389.en: 「Useless.@　The Psylion matches the Series 77 in maneuverability.」

0x0053E5.en: 「Trade your life to learn it...@　the fruit of Project TD.」

0x005507.en: 「To surpass the Psylion... no, to surpass even the Altairlion and Vegalion, that's all we can do!」

0x005597.en: 「But that's the highest difficulty... with no test run!」

0x0055E3.en: 「It's always been do-or-die, hasn't it!@　We're doing it this time too! We'll pull it off! The three of us!」

0x00568B.en: 「Sleigh, you said the Vegalion was empty!@　But you're wrong! We'll fill your machine@　with our... with Filio's soul!」

0x00575E.en: 「Same here, Ibis...!@　But it's a course one step from collision! Brace yourself!」

0x005841.en: 「I'll handle the timing!@　You two focus on controlling the machines!」

0x00589D.en: （Filio... I won't ask you to lend us your strength now!@　Instead, watch over us! All of us!）

0x0059B9.en: 「Filio's dream and ours, Series 77!@　Altair and Vega!」

0x005A3D.en: 「Ibis, take machine control!@　Sleigh, the Tesla Drive and fire control!」

0x005ADC.en: 「Condition green!@　Tesla Drives Alpha, Beta,@　synchronized 100 percent!」

0x005B74.en: 「You two, this machine is the@　crystallization of Project TD, the Hyperion...@　and proof that Filio lived.」

0x005C94.en: 「I'll say it once more!@　Leave this place, Gaia Sabers!!」

0x005CEA.en: 「Fools.@　You just saved me the trouble of catching you one by one.」

0x005D90.en: 「There's no way you can catch@　our Hyperion!」

0x005DF2.en: 「You still talk, looking at these numbers? All units, commence attack. It makes no difference if the pilots die.」

0x005E88.en: 「Let's go, you two!@　Until the day we fly the galaxy with Filio's dream,@　we fight to the end!!」

0x005F5C.en: 「The crystallization of Project TD, the Hyperion.@　...Sleigh's with us too.」

0x006014.en: 「Heh... looks like you've finally found@　what you're meant to do, Sleigh.」

0x006076.en: 「Ibis and Sleigh together...@　Project TD is back to how it should be.」

0x0060F3.en: （My friend... the wings to the stars,@　the light you entrusted... now they've become one.）

0x00616B.en: （Then I'll drive off any who would stand@　before those who carry on your dream.）

0x0061E5.en: （So the Steel Dragons came. In a melee, I might see a chance.@　And if it comes to it, this Psylion@　can escape.）

0x0062A9.en: 「I've finished breaking in the Psylion...@　No matter the gap in machine specs, in the end@　what matters is the pilot's skill.」

0x006345.en: 「I trained in Project TD too!@　When it comes to handling the Series 77,@　I won't lose to anyone!」

0x0063DB.en: 「I'm a professional!@　I won't fall behind some test-pilot@　brat!」

0x006481.en: 「...That's why I told you... to leave this place.」

0x0064C7.en: （Araceli Garcia... even flying the same sky,@　you and Ibis were looking@　at different horizons...）

0x006563.en: （That difference brought this result...@　I understand that now.）

0x006602.en: （Araceli Garcia... you and the Steel Dragons@　were looking at different horizons...）

0x00667A.en: 「All enemy units shot down. No sign of reinforcements.」

0x0066E9.en: （Brother... from today, Sleigh walks@　by his own will...）

0x00673C.en: （And someday...@　in this Hyperion, I'll get to see@　what my brother dreamed of...）

0x0067C3.en: 「The Hyperion...@　With this machine, I really feel like we could@　fly all the way to the edge of the galaxy...」

0x006847.en: 「For that, we'll need to keep@　bringing our strength together.」

0x0068A6.en: 「I know.@　...TD4 to Steel 2. Requesting landing clearance@　for the Vegalion and Sleigh Presty.」

0x00693C.en: 「From today, Sleigh's one of us again.」

0x0069AD.en: 「There are no detours in a star's orbit. It may look roundabout,@　but eventually it returns to the path it should take.」

0x006A2D.en: 「And the journey up to today@　is surely nourishment for you now.」

0x006AA5.en: 「I'll put in a word with Commander Lefina@　myself. So come with us.」

0x006B1D.en: 「My friend Filio would wish for this too.」

0x006B60.en: 「Besides... you had another purpose, didn't you?@　Contacting us alone like this?」

0x006BF6.en: 「I'm carrying a message from Isurugi Heavy@　Industries president Mitsuko Isurugi,@　addressed to Commander Lefina Enfield.」

0x006CF7.en: 「Hard to believe on the face of it...」

0x006D2B.en: 「Mitsuko Isurugi predicted@　you'd react exactly@　this way.」

0x006DA6.en: 「Which is presumably why I was@　chosen as the messenger.」

0x006E02.en: 「Still, we can't deny it might be a trap.@　And I doubt those two would answer such an invitation to begin with.」

0x006E7F.en: 「But he's not the type to make a move without the odds in his favor.」

0x006ECB.en: 「I think so too.@　He must have grasped something that can move them both.」

0x006F27.en: 「Then couldn't he have told us directly,@　without going through Mitsuko Isurugi and Sleigh?」

0x006FA4.en: 「He didn't want us reading his hand.@　And the reason he pulled Isurugi in...@　maybe there's some bad blood between them?」

0x00706A.en: 「If so, then what was that Psylion earlier...?」

0x0070EA.en: 「The point is, like with the President,@　he's telling us to see with our own eyes@　before the information gets manipulated.」

0x007177.en: 「I think a trap is highly likely.@　Besides, our top priority is resupply at Itiiti Island...@　We can't afford to go up to space.」

0x00722B.en: 「Agreed.@　We can't fall into the same trap twice.」

0x00727E.en: 「But what Dr. Shirakawa is trying to do@　could be the opening we need to break out of our situation.」

0x00730A.en: 「So... let's send a few machines that can@　reach space on their own. How's that?」

0x0073BF.en: 「Sleigh... your Hyperion is the machine@　best suited for this mission.」

0x007439.en: 「That means going up to space with Ibis@　and the others. Is that all right?」

0x0074AD.en: 「I'm grateful for the generous treatment@　you've shown in accepting me.」

0x00751B.en: 「Right now, all I want is to help Ibis and the@　others - that's the honest truth.」

0x0075AB.en: 「So the Altairlion and Vegalion can combine...」

0x0075F8.en: 「Altairlion's named for Altair, the Cowherd@ Star, and Vegalion for Vega, the Weaver Girl.@ Together, Series 77 reaches its culmination.」

0x007735.en: 「Yes. That's one origin of the name too.」

0x007772.en: 「Then instead of Hyperion, wouldn't@　'Tanabatalion' be a better name?」

0x0077E6.en: 「Nah, that name's got a bad ring to it.」

0x007811.en: 「Anyway, from today Sleigh's going to be@　fighting alongside us.」

0x007876.en: 「Looking forward to working with you again.」

0x0078A7.en: 「Yes...@　I'm glad Sleigh's come back too.」

0x007900.en: 「I'll be expecting great things from the comet and the meteor.」

0x00796E.en: 「Sleigh, there's someone I want you to meet.@　...Irui, could you come over here?」

0x0079EC.en: 「A kid like this... on a warship...」

0x007A14.en: 「A lot happened, and it fell to us to look after her.」

0x007A5A.en: 「Irui, let me introduce my friend.@　Sleigh Presty... Number 01 of@　<Project TD>, and Vegalion's pilot.」

0x007B13.en: 「Someday, she'll set out with me and Tsugumi@　to reach the sea of stars.」
